title.en: Housing and Development (Assignment of Function) Notification 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Housing and Development (Assignment of Function) Notification 2019 and comes into operation on 25 October 2019.

2. The Minister for National Development assigns to the Housing and Development Board the function of facilitating the dissemination to residents in housing estates of the Board of messages of public interest provided by the Government and public authorities through apparatus using electronic, information and communication technologies.
